name: bento
description: Bento life-OS — access tasks, habits, mood, focus, journal, sleep, notes, goals, and cross-module life intelligence via MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Personal life-OS: tasks, habits, mood, focus, and life intelligence
interface.longDescription: Bento is a personal productivity and life operating system. This plugin gives Codex access to the Bento MCP server, letting it read and write your tasks, habits, mood check-ins, focus sessions, journal entries, sleep logs, notes, goals, meals, and budget transactions. Includes 12+ cross-module intelligence tools for pattern discovery, failure analysis, period comparison, cognitive scheduling, commitment tracking, weekly board reports, and journal narrative generation.
defaultPrompt: Use Bento to check my tasks for today
Use Bento to give me a life overview and spot patterns
Use Bento to log my mood and a focus session
Use Bento to generate a weekly board report
